---
title: position-stack
subtitle: "Stack position adjustment: cumulate y per x bucket."
category: Positions
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


Typically set on a layer as `position: "stack"` rather than constructed
directly; the constructor exists for symmetry with the other positions.

## Usage

```typst
position-stack()
```



## Returns

Position dictionary with `name: "stack"`, consumed by [`plot`](../core/plot.qmd).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/position-stack-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = (
  (q: "Q1", grp: "a", y: 3),
  (q: "Q1", grp: "b", y: 5),
  (q: "Q2", grp: "a", y: 4),
  (q: "Q2", grp: "b", y: 2),
  (q: "Q3", grp: "a", y: 6),
  (q: "Q3", grp: "b", y: 4),
)
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "q", y: "y", fill: "grp"),
  layers: (geom-col(position: "stack"),),
)
```

## See also

[`position-dodge`](position-dodge.qmd), [`position-fill`](position-fill.qmd), [`position-identity`](position-identity.qmd).
